svg.title: E-4 Controller wiring
svg.desc: Modules of the controller core and the panel-specific inputs.
svg.text: Module-level wiring. GPIO numbers are proposals: check each against Heltec's V3 pinout before soldering (Stage 2 gate).
MONOLITH: second OLED shares SPI, own CS
KEY: key switch, removable in OFF
FIRE: big button (both hands on FLIGHTDECK:
ARM + FIRE in series → one input)
1000 µF across 5 V at the chain start
Antenna: IPEX pigtail to an SMA bulkhead
in the case wall; 915 MHz ¼-wave whip.
